tldr: A deep dive using multimodal and long-context LLM capabilities to build four solutions: video transcription with speakers, knowledge graphs from 1M tokens, image bank automation and object editing.
summary: Laurent Picard's session architects four solutions step by step with multimodal and long-context models. The first transcribes videos and identifies speakers in a single prompt; the second extracts entities and relationships from massive inputs of 1M tokens with a single request to generate a knowledge graph.

The remaining two cover an image bank automation pipeline for consistent image generation that revives visual archives, and visual object detection and editing, identifying, restoring and transforming elements within images.
keyPoints: Video transcription with speaker identification in a single prompt.
Knowledge graph generation from 1M-token inputs with one request.
Image bank pipeline for consistent image generation.
Object detection and editing within images.
takeaways: Test whether a single long-context request can replace a multi-step extraction pipeline in your own project.
watchIf: You want to see what multimodal and long-context models can do beyond chat.
